description: This file defines the RemoveRelated class, which implements a method operation for removing related entities in the OFBiz MiniLang framework. It includes logic for executing the removal, gathering artifact info, and a factory class for instantiation.

classes.name: RemoveRelated
classes.description: Implements the <remove-related> element for removing related entities in the MiniLang framework.

classes.name: RemoveRelatedFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of RemoveRelated from XML elements.

methods.name: RemoveRelated
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RemoveRelated object with XML element attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the removal of related entities based on the provided context.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information, specifically the relation name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the RemoveRelated object.
